full_prompt_en: A square, richly painted theatrical illustration shows a dancing couple in ornate costumes against a crowded backdrop of flowers and spectators. The background fills the upper edge with small circular blossoms, warm gold shapes, and dark blue accents, leaving very little empty space. At the left, loosely painted onlookers in muted pink, blue, and brown form a soft row behind the performers. The woman stands in the foreground on the left, her head turned toward her partner. Dark hair is gathered up with a bright floral accent, and her pale face is modeled gently against the dense pattern behind it. Her dress has a golden yellow bodice and a wide skirt that fans across the lower-left corner. White puffed sleeves, orange trim, and tiny red and blue ornament repeat over the fabric, making the garment seem embroidered and layered. At the center, the partner leans in close with one arm extended outward. A dark vest and rust-red boots hold a firm silhouette beneath a sweeping coat, whose broad white sleeve and pink-gold patterned lining open across the right half. Their hands and upper bodies meet near the middle, while the skirt and coat flare in opposing directions to suggest a turn in the dance. Behind the pair, the crowd and flowered wall merge into a shallow decorative field rather than a deep room. The paint has a woven, speckled quality, with small marks accumulating in costumes and background, while the dancers' faces and larger clothing shapes remain readable. Warm even light lifts the pale sleeves and faces without creating a hard spotlight or deep cast shadows. The overall composition is exuberant and tightly filled, combining jewel-toned pattern, sweeping diagonals, and bright costumes into a single theatrical moment.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、色彩浓丽的戏剧性绘画插画呈现一对穿着华丽服装的舞者，背景是拥挤的花饰和观众。背景沿上缘布满细小的圆形花朵、暖金色形状和深蓝色重音，几乎没有空处。左边，以暗粉、蓝色和棕色松松画出的围观者在表演者身后排成柔和的一列。女子站在左侧前景，头转向舞伴。深发盘起，缀着亮色花饰，浅色面容在背后密集纹样的衬托下柔和塑形。她的裙子有金黄色衣身和向左下角展开的宽大裙摆。白色蓬袖、橙色滚边以及细小红蓝纹饰在布面上重复，让衣服显得有刺绣和层叠装饰。画面中央，舞伴俯身靠近，一只手臂向外伸出。深色背心和铁锈红靴子构成稳固剪影，外面一件扬起的长衣以宽大的白袖和粉金色纹样内衬向右半幅展开。两人的手和上半身在中央相接，裙摆与外衣向相反方向张开，暗示旋转的舞步。身后的人群和花饰墙面合成浅而装饰性的场域，没有很深的室内空间。颜料有编织般的斑点质感，细小笔迹在服装与背景中积聚，舞者面部和较大的衣服形状仍清晰可辨。均匀的暖光提亮浅色衣袖和脸庞，没有强硬的聚光或浓重投影。整体构图欢腾而饱满，把宝石色纹样、挥舞的斜线和明亮服装合成一个戏剧性的瞬间。
style_prompt_en: The painting combines broad flowing contours with densely accumulated ornamental marks. Warm gold, rust, coral pink, cream, cobalt blue, and dark green repeat in many small intervals, so large shapes stay lively without losing their outline. Matte pigment and speckled, almost woven surface texture give patterned areas a tactile depth. Pale volumes emerge from darker, busier fields; contrasting color areas guide the eye through sweeping diagonals and outward flares. Shadows are gentle and warm, with little sense of a single theatrical spotlight, while small high-value accents brighten the densely colored surface. Space remains shallow and decorative, packing peripheral detail around a readable center. The overall effect is festive and stage-like, with rhythmic ornament and expansive movement carrying the visual style.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画把宽阔流动的轮廓与密集累积的装饰性笔迹结合起来。暖金、铁锈红、珊瑚粉、奶油白、钴蓝与深绿在许多细小间隔中反复出现，使大形体活跃，又不丢失轮廓。哑光颜料和斑点密布、近似织物的表面肌理让纹样区域有可触的深度。浅色体块从更深、更繁密的色域中浮现；对照的色面沿着扫出的斜线和外扩的形体引导视线。阴影柔和而偏暖，几乎没有单一戏剧性聚光的感觉，细小的高明度重音则点亮密集色面。空间保持浅而装饰性，让外围细节围绕清晰的中心聚集。整体效果欢庆而具有舞台感，节奏鲜明的纹饰和舒展的运动感构成主要画风。
theme_en: A dancing couple in ornate costumes before a festive crowd
theme_zh: 一对身着华丽服装的舞者在节庆人群前起舞
name: Sergei Diaghilev
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
